CASE
  WHEN Parent_Response_Rate < 15 THEN "🔴 High Risk"
  WHEN Parent_Response_Rate < 30 THEN "🟡 Watch"
  ELSE "🟢 Healthy"
END

CASE
  WHEN Teacher_Response_Rate < 60 THEN "🔴 High Risk"
  WHEN Teacher_Response_Rate < 80 THEN "🟡 Watch"
  ELSE "🟢 Healthy"
END

CASE
  WHEN Student_Response_Rate < 60 THEN "🔴 High Risk"
  WHEN Student_Response_Rate < 80 THEN "🟡 Watch"
  ELSE "🟢 Healthy"
END

CASE
  WHEN 5essentials_overall_score >= 60 THEN "🟢 Strong"
  WHEN 5essentials_overall_score >= 50 THEN "🟡 Developing"
  WHEN 5essentials_overall_score >= 40 THEN "🟠 Watch"
  ELSE "🔴 Intensive Support"
END

CASE
  WHEN Parent_Response_Rate < 15 OR 5essentials_overall_score < 40 THEN "🔴 Priority"
  WHEN Parent_Response_Rate < 30 OR 5essentials_overall_score < 50 THEN "🟡 Monitor"
  ELSE "🟢 Stable"
END

CASE
  WHEN 5essentials_overall_score_Growth_2024_to_2026 >= 10 THEN "🚀 Major Growth"
  WHEN 5essentials_overall_score_Growth_2024_to_2026 >= 5 THEN "📈 Growth"
  WHEN 5essentials_overall_score_Growth_2024_to_2026 > -5 THEN "➡ Stable"
  ELSE "📉 Decline"
END

CASE
  WHEN Pct_Favorable >= 80 THEN "🟢 Strength"
  WHEN Pct_Favorable >= 65 THEN "🟡 Adequate"
  WHEN Pct_Favorable >= 50 THEN "🟠 Concern"
  ELSE "🔴 Critical Concern"
END

CASE
  WHEN Role = "Student" AND Pct_Favorable < 50 THEN "🔴 Student Concern"
  WHEN Role = "Student" AND Pct_Favorable >= 80 THEN "🟢 Student Strength"
  ELSE ""
END

CASE
  WHEN Role = "Teacher" AND Pct_Favorable < 50 THEN "🔴 Teacher Concern"
  WHEN Role = "Teacher" AND Pct_Favorable >= 80 THEN "🟢 Teacher Strength"
  ELSE ""
END

CASE
  WHEN Subgroup_Gap >= 25 THEN "🔴 Large Gap"
  WHEN Subgroup_Gap >= 15 THEN "🟡 Moderate Gap"
  ELSE "🟢 Limited Gap"
END
